verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a Disputes API for programmatic retrieval and automated management of disputes, and an Agent Toolkit/MCP server that exposes PayPal APIs to agent frameworks via function calling, suggesting an agent could plausibly retrieve and respond to disputes end-to-end. However, there is no explicit evidence of an evidence-assembly or dispute-response submission endpoint, nor any documented example of an agent completing a full dispute workflow, and community evidence highlights inconsistent/adverse dispute outcomes even for human-handled cases.
